_what: independent cross-encoders voting the shipped top-2, fit split
_decisive_test: does any rule fire CORRECTLY above the 0.084 near-tie band? every prior mechanism scored 0 there, which is what makes them coin flips with extra steps.

arms.rule: swap if >= 1 of 5 voters prefer rank-2
swap if >= 2 of 5 voters prefer rank-2
swap if >= 3 of 5 voters prefer rank-2
swap if >= 4 of 5 voters prefer rank-2
swap if >= 5 of 5 voters prefer rank-2
swap if ALL voters prefer rank-2
unanimous AND inside the near-tie band
